findings: The adopted private Elm/WebKit + Haskell UI/localHTTP owner, single host-side native authority, ordinary applications host placement remains the target. No release/privateGUI completion prerequisite is invented for starting this source slice.

Three distinct exact127.0.0.1 listener origins establish browser role isolation. Role is assigned by listener, never request body/header/path. POST requires same-role Origin; every API request including consuming GET/events requires X-Warlock-Api:1. Cross-origin browser custom-header fetch preflights OPTIONS, which is denied. Ordinary document/image/simple GET cannot consume events.

Canonical whole view-commit framed IPC remains on inheritedfd0 written only by original approved UI owner PID. fd0CLOEXEC precedes WebKit subprocess creation. RendererHTTP only creates typed renderer provenance; native-event/topology/disposition/dismiss/escape/reflow cannot be chosen by HTTP client.

HTTP and port roots share pure DesktopPolicy and Bar/Popup transition logic. One interpreter is chosen by pinned artifact; do not leave two active effect paths or duplicate policy. No authored JavaScript adapter, init string or JSC extension is required: exact compiler standaloneHTML/script/style bytes remain separately pinned.

Exact local asset route and Host/method/Origin/content-type/Content-Length/body/version guards are fail closed before callbacks, including duplicate headers/case variants, transfer-encoding, trailing bytes, path encoding, unknown routes/methods and unapproved capabilities. No wildcard CORS, redirects, file path mapping or directory fallback.

CSP defaults deny, allows exact compiler script/style hashes and same-role connect origin, excludes unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval/remote/frame/object/base/form/worker access. Header construction is source evidence only; actual engine execution-negative observations remain required.

WebKit decide-policy must actively default deny unknown cases and reject newwindow/download/remote navigation. Resource-load-started and WebResource.sent-request are observations, not blocking hooks. Real compiled UserContentFilter is installed successfully before first load, alongside exactCSP and assetmap.

No synthetic initial topology/window snapshot/binding or view-disposition is introduced. HTTP receipt is not presentation/native admission. Existing16retainedbatch obligations and nativeOperations empty remain unchanged.

Startup requires actual owned private network and pinned engine dependency closure; absence fails closed, never host-network/software/device fallback. Existing absolute Bootstrap deadline<=30s remains bounded and all listeners/queues/workers/filter/native refs have explicit owned cleanup.
